title: Hand Wash Time
yt_description:
Learn to wash hands before eating with Pip. This song teaches the importance of hand washing in a fun way. Help your child develop good hygiene habits.

🎵 Hand Wash Time

Pip is hungry
Time to eat

Hands are dirty
Need soap now

Wash hands clean
Before we eat

Wash hands clean
Before we eat

Hands are clean
Time to eat

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
